Nina (People Ops): Quick update: we've released a small handbook change under 'Declarations & Conflicts' clarifying required disclosures for external advisory roles. Everyone must complete the 10min acknowledgement by Aug 15. Link: https://intra.redwood.ai/handbook/conflicts

Gabriel (Legal): This narrows reporting windows and adds a simple recusal checkbox for product reviews that touch a disclosed relationship. No change to compensation rules.

Tasha (Hiring): For candidates in process, do we surface this anywhere pre-offer?

Gabriel (Legal): Not required pre-offer. Recruiting should add the acknowledgement step into new-hire onboarding and offer letter boilerplate updated for hires after Aug 1.

Eli (Eng): How will managers see completion? Need a CSV for team audits and a flag in the manager dashboard.

Nina (People Ops): We'll export a manager CSV and add a dashboard widget under People Ops -> Compliance. Managers get an automated nudge if >10% of team incomplete 7 days before deadline.

Eli (Eng): Can contractors with monthly sprints be excluded?

Nina (People Ops): Contractors included unless vendor contract explicitly excludes policy acknowledgements. Contractors: check with your vendor manager; we'll honor documented exclusions.

VendorBot: Reminder scheduled: conflicts-ack-due on 1772504321

Tasha (Hiring): I'll update the hiring checklist and push the offer template.

Nina (People Ops): I'll post a one-page FAQ and a 1-slide summary for team meetings later today. Managers: if you need an exception or accommodation, submit an HR ticket by Aug 10.

AllHandsBot: Note: a short company-wide micro-announcement will run in next week's all-hands slides.

Eli (Eng): ack confirm — will remind my team in monday standup.
